title: Block layout
description: The arrangement of one block's members in the block frame (RFC 11 Sections 6.1 and 6.10). Immutable: a changed member pose is a new block layout. Every member sits on the side the block is placed on.

circuit.description: The circuit whose binding this arranges (RFC 3 Section 10).

pack.description: The content hash of the part pack whose rules or geometry produced it.

fit.description: How the pack's geometry applies to this board. A block that does not fit is held and has no layout.

pose.description: In the block frame: origin at the centroid of the anchor's pads, axes of the anchor's footprint frame.

source.description: The pack rule or geometry, constraint, or run that produced the pose.

envelope.description: The smallest rectangle, with sides along the block frame's axes, that encloses every member's courtyard (or, for a member without one, its pads' copper) and the block's keepouts (RFC 11 Section 6.10). Conservative: it may enclose space no member uses.

ports.description: Where each external net leaves the block.

facing.description: The direction the net leaves in, in the block frame, as a rotation from the +x axis.

results.description: The result of each constraint the binding instantiates.
